about: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (official MXFP4/MXFP8 checkpoint) on 4x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, TP4, 512K, 8 sequences: kacper-daftcode/vLLM-Moet r13 (vLLM nightly df3bd094 + sm_120 steps 1-28: MXFP8 GEMV, FP4 KV record + MXFP4 indexer, b12x MoE with the fused decode kernel, sparse-MLA gather loads, MXFP8 lm_heads, PCIe P2P all-reduce in NCCL's order), DSpark k=7, KV offload to 32 GiB host RAM + an in-container disk tier, and the engram_disk layer (Engram tables read from the checkpoint on NVMe instead of ~330 GB of host shm). Image: sybil-solutions/local-ai-images vllm-moet-dsv41.
setup: NEEDS (measured on the reference host with the recipe kit's memwatch, before launch to peak): 4x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB (sm_120) in ONE machine with GPU peer-to-peer over PCIe (cudaDeviceCanAccessPeer true for every pair; the P2P all-reduce and NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS rely on it), 368,132 MiB VRAM in use at ready (0.94) / 387,916 MiB peak; host RAM: 47 GB MemAvailable drop at peak (32 GiB of it is the pinned KV offload region, which lives in the container's /dev/shm, hence --shm-size 48g); disk: 510.3 GB of weights on local NVMe (Engram rows are read from the checkpoint at every decode step) + the 9.6 GB image; the KV disk tier writes into the container's own filesystem (/srv/kvcache) and goes away with it. FIRST START: FlashInfer autotune + DeepGEMM JIT run in the container (~22 min upstream, nothing is cached across --rm containers); then 9.69M GPU KV tokens (18.5x concurrency at 524,288). MEASURED on the reference host (Threadripper PRO 9965WX, 125 GiB RAM, PCIe 5.0, 300 W per GPU, stock memory clock; same vLLM-Moet 5d25cff + engram_disk build tagged locally, warm caches, a serving box with other agent traffic during the sweep): recipe kit sweep, natural completions, no output caps (https://github.com/sybil-solutions/local-ai-recipe-kit/blob/321e7a4ffe9e627d5bb899fb83ecada5deb57580/submissions/4x-rtx-pro-6000-96gb/2026-10-21-0xSero.json): prefill 8k 8,944 / 16k 9,937 / 32k 10,695 / 64k 11,119 tok/s; decode C1 137.6, C2 191.7, C3 202.5, C4 263.2, C8 271.7 tok/s aggregate (prose), C1 at 32k 73.1 tok/s. vLLM-Moet's single-stream code bench (tools/sm120_perf/fraser_bench.py, 2,048 tokens, 10 reps, 2026-10-21): median 403 tok/s (live traffic), undisturbed reps 557-573 tok/s at 5.4-5.6 accepted tokens per step; upstream reports 641 median / 686 best at 325 W with +5000 MHz memory and the Engram table in host RAM. QUALITY vs a stock-kernel reference (the same image with every VLLM_MOET_* switch 0, fp8_ds_mla KV, fp8 indexer, default MoE, no speculative decoding; 8 prompts, 1,953 teacher-forced positions; https://github.com/sybil-solutions/local-ai-recipe-kit/blob/321e7a4ffe9e627d5bb899fb83ecada5deb57580/targets/deepseek-v4.1-flash-4x-rtx-pro-6000.md): top-1 agreement 0.974, mean KL 0.0195 (reference vs itself 0.9995 / 0.00019); needle PASS at 245K and 510K. Lossy by design: the FP4 KV record, MXFP4 indexer keys, b12x 8-bit MoE activations and the MXFP8 target lm_head; every other switch is bit-identical to the path it replaces (VLLM_MOET_*=0 falls back to stock). Decode is power-bound: record the GPU power limit with any number.
